title: Clients submit and control commands through a portable service API
description:
As an authenticated platform client, I want to submit, inspect, and cancel structured commands through a deployment-neutral service contract, so that command execution does not depend on a particular dashboard, cloud, broker, or worker implementation.

Feature: Portable command service API
  Scenario: Submit a new structured command
    Given an authenticated principal belongs to a tenant
    When the principal submits a valid command with an idempotency key
    Then the command is durably announced for dispatch
    And its initial status can be retrieved within that tenant

  Scenario: Repeat an identical submission
    Given a command was submitted with an idempotency key
    When the same tenant repeats the identical submission
    Then the original command is returned without creating another dispatch

  Scenario: Reuse an idempotency key for different input
    Given a command was submitted with an idempotency key
    When the same tenant submits different command input with that key
    Then the request is rejected as an idempotency conflict

  Scenario: Access another tenant command
    Given a command belongs to another tenant
    When a principal attempts to inspect or cancel it
    Then the service reveals no command information

  Scenario: Request cancellation
    Given a nonterminal command belongs to the principal tenant
    When cancellation is requested
    Then the durable command state records that request idempotently

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Acceptance contract landed in develop via PR #538: authenticated submit/get/cancel service, scoped idempotency, tenant non-disclosure, cancellation semantics, audit evidence, and late-delivery integrity protections.
